title: scribbit-signet-faucet environment
description: Environment of the HTTP server (src/main.ts, parsed by src/config.ts). Signet only. The faucet is OFF by default (FAUCET_WALLET=off: drips answer 503 faucet_disabled). The only secrets are the bitcoind RPC credentials, injected from the secret store paths listed in component.yaml. Values are strings, as in any environment.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Absolute base URL clients use. Advertised on GET /.

FAUCET_WALLET.description: Wallet adapter. off: disabled. bitcoind: sendtoaddress on a signet node's wallet (the process refuses to start unless getblockchaininfo reports chain=signet). fake: in-memory, invented txids (local development and demos only; nothing is broadcast).

BITCOIND_RPC_URL.description: Signet node RPC base, e.g. http://bitcoind.internal.example:38332. No credentials in the URL. Required with FAUCET_WALLET=bitcoind.

BITCOIND_RPC_WALLET.description: Name of the loaded signet wallet that funds drips. Required with FAUCET_WALLET=bitcoind.

FAKE_WALLET_BALANCE_SATS.description: Starting balance of the fake wallet (FAUCET_WALLET=fake).

DAILY_BUDGET_SATS.description: Global budget per UTC day; drips answer 503 budget_exhausted past it until 00:00 UTC.

ADDRESS_DRIPS_PER_DAY.description: Token bucket per address (capacity, refilled over 24 h).

IP_DRIPS_PER_DAY.description: Token bucket per client IP (capacity, refilled over 24 h).

POW_DIFFICULTY.description: Leading zero bits required (1..32). Expected client work is 2^difficulty SHA-256 hashes; 20 is about a million.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the faucet, e.g. https://scribb.it. Default none.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of proxies we run; X-Forwarded-For is read only from them (client IP for the per-IP limits).

EXPLORER_URL.description: Signet explorer base for the explorerUrl in drip responses (`/tx/<txid>` is appended).
